You understand the strengths of your team members, deploy them accordingly, and support their development potential, with a keen sensitivity for cultural differences and working styles.- A degree in business administration or law (or equivalent), and a passed qualification as a Tax Advisor (Steuerberaterexamen), Specialist Lawyer in International Tax Law (Examen als Fachanwalt für internationales Steuerrecht), or comparable qualification in Germany or abroad- Possess at least 10 years of professional experience in consulting (ideally Big Four), in a comparable role in corporate finance, or in the tax department of a multinational corporation- Have extensive experience advising other multinational corporations on national and international tax planning- Demonstrate long-standing experience in international M&A transactions (including Tax Due Diligence, SPA Tax Advice, structuring, and integration)- Possess profound knowledge of transformation law and transformation tax law (Umwandlungs- und Umwandlungssteuerrecht), as well as international tax law (Außensteuerrecht), corporate income tax law (Körperschaftsteuerrecht), and trade tax law (Gewerbesteuerrecht)- Be able to accurately assess the impact of tax planning measures on other functions (e.g., Supply Chain, Value Flow, Accounting, Legal, etc.)- Preferably possess basic industry knowledge and fundamental knowledge of corporate law (Gesellschaftsrecht), and enjoy working in multinational teams- Have excellent communication skills in German and English, both spoken and written#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Alexander GreieLinkedIn Profile (http://linkedin.com/in/alexander-greie)

jobs.occupation: AI Governance & Literacy Manager (m/w/d) in Friedrichshafen (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Artificial Intelligence is transforming businesses – and you ensure that innovation is implemented responsibly. As an AI Compliance Manager , you will play a key role at the intersection of AI Governance , the EU AI Act , Compliance , and Project Management . You will advise business units, actively shape governance processes, and help create the framework for the secure and compliant use of AI applications. Join an international team where English is the working language and contribute your expertise in a future-oriented environment in Friedrichshafen .Die vorliegende Stelle ist im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung zu besetzen.AI Governance & Literacy Manager (m/w/d) in FriedrichshafenIhre Aufgaben:• Coordinate the approval process for new AI applications from initial assessment to implementation.• Evaluate business needs and risks together with cross-functional stakeholders.• Collaborate closely with the AI Committee, Legal, Data Privacy, HR, Works Council, and international colleagues.• Ensure compliance with the EU AI Act and internal AI governance policies.• Maintain the AI Registry and advise business units on AI Governance topics.Ihre Qualifikationen:• Take on a strategically important role in one of the fastest-growing areas of digital transformation.• Work in an international environment with excellent opportunities to expand your expertise.• Be part of a collaborative team where your ideas and initiative are valued.• Gain experience in a highly relevant field with potential future career opportunities.• Start on a 12-month temporary assignment with the possibility of extension or internal opportunities, subject to business needs.Was Sie erwartet:• Take on a strategically important role in one of the fastest-growing areas of digital transformation.• Work in an international environment with excellent opportunities to expand your expertise.• Be part of a collaborative team where your ideas and initiative are valued.• Gain experience in a highly relevant field with potential future career opportunities.• Start on a 12-month temporary assignment with the possibility of extension or internal opportunities, subject to business needs.If you want to do more than simply follow regulations and would like to actively shape the future of responsible AI, we would love to hear from you. As an AI Compliance Manager , you will join an international environment where your expertise makes a real impact while helping to drive AI Governance forward in Friedrichshafen .\n\nSämtliche Personenbezeichnungen gelten gleichermaßen für alle Geschlechter.

jobs.occupation: Lead, Photography (x/f/m) (Werbefotograf/in)
jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.The roleAs a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.What you’ll do- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellenceWhat you’ll bring- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English_________________Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Lichttechnik, Beleuchtung, Bildbearbeitung, digital, Werbefotografie
